name: mac-maintenance-skills
description: Claude Code skills for cleaning up and speeding up a Mac: a read-only survey of what takes space and memory, a safe tier that removes only caches programs recreate, hash-verified duplicate files moved to the Trash, and leftovers of uninstalled apps. Standard-library scripts, no network.

plugins.name: mac-maintenance
plugins.description: Three skills, each with a tested standard-library script: mac-cleanup (survey, safe tier, decision report), mac-duplicate-finder and mac-app-leftovers.
